name: Lamu mtepe sewn-plank vessels
description: A Swahili coastal sailing vessel described as built from sewn planking.

places.note: Place refers to the sourced event; historic political boundaries are not inferred.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A locally built mtepe model from Lamu is catalogued to 1901–1930.

evidence.supports: The museum dates a locally made, rigged wooden mtepe model from Lamu to 1901–1930 and lists its maker as unknown; it is a scale model, not a surviving working boat.

events.caveats: The object is a model; its maker is unknown and the dating range does not prove a working vessel was built in any particular year.

date.basis: Date stated in the cited source.

events.statement: A 1937 description identifies mtepe hulls of the Lamu coast as sewn planks.

evidence.supports: Hornell says the mtepe of the Lamu coast had sewn hull planks; his wider article offers racialized and disputed cultural-origin speculation that is not adopted here. Publication date is not a directly observed construction date.

events.caveats: The description does not establish a specific vessel’s construction date or a reliable route of transmission.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest event for this scoped capability established by the inspected passages; no global priority is inferred.

unresolved.note: The model and 1937 description do not establish an origin date, named shipwright, or transmission to any represented Indian Ocean vessel.
